## Learning goals

- I can use colour for emphasis without making colour the only cue.
- I can test contrast at the final size and on the final output.
- I can revise a design after another person tries to read or use it.

![Four panels compare text over a busy background, text on a solid background, a thin outline, and a heavy 3D effect.](../../assets/accessible-design/text-legibility-examples.svg){fig-alt="The solid background and thin outline examples remain easiest to read; the busy background and heavy 3D effect interfere with the letters."}

## Test the real result

Show the design without explaining it. Ask what the person noticed first and what was difficult to understand. For a fabricated design, make a small sample and check thin lines, small gaps, inside spaces, and contrast before making the final piece.
